scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
